{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check total number of rows
total_rows = len(sales_df)
print(f'Total number of rows in sales data: {total_rows}')

# Check number of valid age rows
valid_age_df = sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] >= 0]
valid_rows = len(valid_age_df)
print(f'Number of rows with valid age (age >= 0): {valid_rows}')

# Compute mean age on valid age rows
mean_age = valid_age_df['customer_age'].mean()
print(f'Mean age of customers with valid age: {mean_age}')"}
